core_obligations: Deformation category setup (proof lines 5776-5785): (RS*) gives (RS), so the fibres are deformation categories and the tangent/Inf spaces make sense.
Reduction to k (proof lines 5787-5800): base change identifies X_0's stack with the 2-fibre product; the fibre-product lemma plus finite dimensionality for B and Spec(k) reduce to B = Spec(k).

Tangent identification (proof lines 5802-5825): X_epsilon is a flat first order thickening with equivalent etale topoi; the thickening lemma identifies T F with lift classes, and the deformation theory lemma computes it as Ext^1_{O_{X_0}}(E_0, E_0).
Inf and finiteness (proof lines 5826-5843): Ext^0 surjects onto Inf; E_0 lies in D^b_Coh on the quasi-compact Noetherian X_0, so both Exts are finite dimensional.
proof_roadmap: Set up deformation categories via (RS*) (proof lines 5776-5785).
Reduce to B = Spec(k) by base change and fibre-product tangent calculus (proof lines 5787-5800).
Identify the tangent space with Ext^1 via the thickening (proof lines 5802-5825).
Bound Inf via Ext^0 and conclude finiteness (proof lines 5826-5843).
